payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-24: MHAS here means the Mental Health Advocacy Service; written as SVC-LEG-004 from its wa.gov.au pages (replaces legacy S100), unsigned, awaiting owner clinical:review. SARC needs no separate record (SVC-SV-001 already covers counselling and is signed). Only Zonta House remains, blocked: its operator (Zonta House Refuge Association) is not a registered publisher and zontahouse.org.au is not an approved source site, and registering it edits the protected source-authority registry, so it needs the owner decision (precedent docs/decisions/2026-09-26-register-wa-service-issuers.md).
